title: Orientalist Anglicist Controversy
definition: A fierce 19th-century policy debate within the British East India Company administration regarding the medium of instruction, content, and objectives of education to be promoted in British India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Modern Indian History (GS-1) covering British administrative policies, socio-cultural impacts, and the evolution of modern Indian education from the Charter Act of 1813 to Macaulay's Minute of 1835.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of the Orientalist Anglicist Controversy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Early British administrative policies in India
Introduction of Western education in colonial India
